title: Notice, Rescheduling and Late-Arrival Settings for Each Appointment Series Format
content:
The settings below govern, format by format, how much notice an Appointment Series cancellation needs, how same-week reschedules and the reschedule allowance work, what happens when a patient arrives late, and how soon the clinic offers a replacement after it cancels an appointment itself.

## Table 1 — notice and rescheduling

| Visit format | Minimum notice for a cancellation not to be a late cancellation | Voicemail cancellation timed by its timestamp | Same-week reschedule avoids the late-cancellation fee | Minimum notice for that same-week reschedule | Maximum reschedules per series | Replacement offered after a clinic cancellation within |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 24 hours | Yes | Yes | 2 hours | 6 | 7 calendar days |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 24 hours | Yes | Yes | 2 hours | 6 | 7 calendar days |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 24 hours | Yes | Yes | 2 hours | 6 | 7 calendar days |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 24 hours | Yes | No | 0 hours | 4 | 7 calendar days |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 48 hours | Yes | No | 0 hours | 3 | 14 calendar days |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 24 hours | Yes | Yes | 2 hours | 6 | 2 calendar days |

A same-week reschedule is a move of the appointment into the same Monday-to-Sunday week. The minimum notice for it is counted in hours before the original appointment, and it is 0 for a format where a same-week reschedule does not avoid the fee.

## Table 2 — late arrival

| Visit format | Grace period after the start (minutes) | Arrival later than the grace period is recorded as | Arrival within the grace period is seen for the remaining slot time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 10 | a no-show | Yes |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 15 | a late cancellation | Yes |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 15 | a late cancellation | Yes |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 10 | a late cancellation | No |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 15 | a late cancellation | Yes |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 15 | a late cancellation | Yes |

The grace period is the number of minutes after the appointment start within which a late-arriving patient is still seen.

## Worked readings (hypothetical)

- A Specialty One-on-One Visit Series appointment cancelled 30 hours ahead gives less than the 48 hours that format requires, so it is a late cancellation; the same 30 hours on a Standard 45-Minute Visit Series meets the 24-hour minimum.
- A patient reaching a Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series appointment 12 minutes after the start is beyond the 10-minute grace period and is recorded as a no-show; a patient 12 minutes late to a Standard 45-Minute Visit Series appointment is within its 15-minute grace period.
